# Jesel Cura

Jesel Cura is a fractional customer success manager and operations consultant for SaaS, Shopify, and service-based teams that need clearer onboarding, support workflows, CRM systems, SOPs, retention, and customer operations.

## Key URLs

- https://www.jeselcura.me/
  - Overview of Jesel Cura's fractional customer success and operations consulting services.
- https://www.jeselcura.me/services/

- https://www.jeselcura.me/fractional-customer-success-consultant/
  - Fractional CS support for onboarding, account operations, retention workflows, and customer health visibility.
- https://www.jeselcura.me/customer-success-operations-consultant/
  - Customer success operations consulting for CRM hygiene, reporting, lifecycle workflows, and SOPs.
- https://www.jeselcura.me/shopify-ecommerce-operations-support/

- https://www.jeselcura.me/operations-audit/

- https://www.jeselcura.me/customer-onboarding-consultant/
